Base R6 class for SAR and PolSAR statistical models

Source: R/models.R
SARModel.Rd

SARModel is the abstract parent of all model classes of SITSAR (GammaSAR, G0I, GGammaSAR, WishartSAR, G0Polarimetric and CompoundWishart). Every model can evaluate densities, simulate data, be fitted by maximum likelihood ($fit()) and report its Shannon entropy and the asymptotic variance of the entropy estimator.

Fitted models work with the generics verbs tidy(), glance(), as well as with stats::logLik() and stats::AIC().

Public fields

name

Model name.

params

Named list of parameters.

fixed

Names of parameters held fixed during estimation.

n

Sample size used in the last fit (NULL if not fitted).

loglik

Maximised log-likelihood (NULL if not fitted).

converged

Logical convergence flag of the last fit.
